Post description was 173 characters; venture preflight's front-matter check caught it (160 max).

Installed build123d in a venv, regenerated the feeder package, cad suite 130/130 OK.

doc_friction.issue: Says venture suites can outlast the 120 s timeout; open-tennis-robots took 116 s for 268 tests, right at the edge, so background was the right call.

venture-preflight runs front-matter and run-record checks that fail on an unfilled record by design; running it before filling the record costs one rerun. Saying 'fill the run record first' would save a pass.

Any new Feeder field changes the committed manifest's params; run_venture_tests skips the build123d tests that catch it, so a params-only change looks green locally. Worth a line: 'changed params.py? regenerate manufacturing/feeder'.

notes: Three-inertia lift plant (rotor - jaw coupling spring with gap and damping - shaft side 1.24e-6 kg m^2 - slip hub - belt), mechanics at 12.5 us. Switched starts ring the 49 Hz mode: loaded 0.43-0.61 N m through the hub vs 0.26 assumed; empty with stiff worn spider slips the hub. Firmware LIFT_RAMP_MS=100 soft start restores 0.24-0.26 N m loaded and no slips except 5 deg at 80 N m/rad (1/6). Jams unchanged: coupling capped at hub's 1.08 N m (rated 2.0), flights 46-90 N. Verification: run_venture_tests.py open-tennis-robots: 268 tests, 0 failed, 53 skipped (build123d); page.test.mjs pass; venture-preflight first run failed only on post description length and the unfilled record, rerun after fixes. cad CI failed once on the stale committed manifest; regenerated with build123d 0.13.0 in a venv (feeder only changed manifest.json + zip), cad unittest 130 OK locally.
